column1: # The shrine entry narration, captured while it is still printing.
# **Fixed 2026-09-12.** `karma.md` Section 12's entry table paces this - the
# approach record, the kneel record, then "After ten world ticks, record `29`:
# the question asking which virtue". The engine used to print all three inside
# the one key handler, so both sampled beats showed the original still on
# `tranquil Shrine...` while the engine was already asking the virtue.
# `crates/u5-runtime/src/narration.rs` stages them now. Four things had to be
# right together, and each was measured:
#   - the hold before the kneel record, which Section 12 does not give
#   - record `45`'s own trailing blank row, which Section 12 does specify and
#   - no leading feed on the kneel record, since that trailing blank is
#   - and no answer row, no end cap and no cursor while the hold runs - the
#     question has not been asked yet, and a held page reads no key.
# requires-seed: the party on the published Honesty shrine coordinate
